scope: Development corpus agreement with original Lexicon 1.11.15.0 timing worker, not musical ground truth or cue/energy evaluation
audio_identity: Exact decoded S16 PCM MD5 checked against frozen input manifest before every prediction; encoded snapshot/source SHA256 checked before and after. All source mtimes had drifted.
timing_limits: Ten concurrent disjoint shards plus one single-track retry. Rust includes full native decode and default DSP key analysis; original-worker boundary times timing only. Not a controlled speed comparison or shipping-UI throughput measurement.
heldout_limits: Tuning only; no reference-label manifest read. An earlier separate diagnostic exposed timing for one reserved group, documented in the exposure audit. No claim that all held-out groups are untouched.

cue_decision_pilot.selection: Every tenth sorted tuning group, ordinals1,11,...281, fixed before predictions
cue_decision_pilot.boundary: Original worker cue entry with verified prior original timing, complete native first-channel PCM and independently computed scalar seven-stage default-Q lowpass input. Rust fresh complete analysis supplies its own timing/frontend/cues. Exact positions, names, colors and emergency-loop result compared. Not installed Chromium128 renderer/file-decode equivalence or musical ground truth.
cue_decision_pilot.correction: Preserve the source fractional transient threshold instead of truncating to an integer. Nine authored original-helper references verify it independently of music.
cue_decision_pilot.source_integrity: Every source snapshot/source SHA and frozen decoded S16 PCM MD5 guard passed; no source writes.
